description: What a conditional declares is what its branches agree on, the same fold a set operation applies: strings to the WIDEST length, numbers so the widest INTEGER PART meets the widest SCALE (NUMBER(5,4) beside NUMBER(10,0) is NUMBER(14,4), not (10,4)), temporals of one flavour to the wider precision - and CASE, DECODE and NVL2 answer identically to IFF and COALESCE. DECODE and NVL2's branches are only their RESULT arguments: NVL2's tested first argument and DECODE's expression and searches contribute nothing, DECODE's trailing default exists only on an even argument count, and a mixed pair refuses in the conditionals' Can-not-convert words. Converted 1:1 from expressions/ConditionalDeclaredTypeTest + expressions/DecodeAndNvl2BranchesTest (now retired).
